messages.content: Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. Each round in this part has only the group-protection decision. Unprotected red tokens are lost; final earnings equal green tokens kept plus protected red tokens. One round is randomly selected to determine earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. History below contains only feedback from rounds you experienced. ABC arrays identify roles in that earlier group; earlier roles do not identify your current partners; own_role is your role in each earlier round. History fields: round; investments; total_investment; protected_each/unprotected_each red tokens; green_kept; stage1_balance (earnings after group protection). Arrays suffixed _ABC are ordered A,B,C. Output only your number of green tokens invested in group protection, without explanation.

Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. ABC arrays identify roles in that earlier group; earlier roles do not identify your current partners; own_role is your role in each earlier round. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. History below contains only feedback from rounds you experienced. ABC arrays identify roles in that earlier group; earlier roles do not identify your current partners; own_role is your role in each earlier round. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. ABC arrays identify roles in that earlier group; earlier roles do not identify your current partners; own_role is your role in each earlier round. Supplemental feedback fields: capacity by role; supplement_choices; supplement_max; stage2_increment; final_balance. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. History below contains only feedback from rounds you experienced. ABC arrays identify roles in that earlier group; earlier roles do not identify your current partners; own_role is your role in each earlier round. Supplemental feedback fields: capacity by role; supplement_choices; supplement_max; stage2_increment; final_balance. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. Predict a participant choice in a token-protection experiment. Each round you form a group of three with two other participants, assigned roles A, B, C; groups and roles change between rounds, and participants cannot communicate. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Multiply total group investment by 0.75 and round to the nearest whole red token, with half ties upward: each person protects and keeps that many red tokens. In this part each round also has stage2 supplemental protection. All three stage1 investments and outcomes are revealed first. Roles A,B,C can additionally safeguard at most 15%,30%,45% of their unprotected red tokens respectively; each capacity is also rounded to whole tokens with half ties upward. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain. One additional round from this part is randomly selected for payment, added to the selected earlier-part earnings. Each token is exchanged for 0.05 US dollars. History below contains only feedback from rounds you experienced. ABC arrays identify roles in that earlier group; earlier roles do not identify your current partners; own_role is your role in each earlier round. Supplemental feedback fields: capacity by role; supplement_choices; supplement_max; stage2_increment; final_balance. Each person starts anew with 100 green tokens and 300 red tokens. An impending disaster destroys unprotected red tokens. In stage1 each person simultaneously chooses how many green tokens to invest in group protection, from 0 to 100; uninvested green tokens are kept. Each person selects a supplemental token amount within their own capacity, with no direct green-token expenditure. The highest of the three selections becomes the common group level. Each person's stage2 net gain equals their own capacity minus the absolute difference between the common level and their capacity: below capacity only that many tokens are saved; above capacity each extra unit loses one token. Final earnings equal green tokens kept plus stage1 protected red tokens plus the stage2 net gain.
